release_name: v0.11.4 - Download Error Tracking & Security Fixes
features: 🐛 Fixed: Download errors now properly stored in database
🐛 Fixed: Failed downloads now appear in history with error messages
🔧 Enhanced: Download records created for all failures (even if history cleared)
🔒 Security: YouTube API keys sanitized from error messages
🔍 Enhanced: Artist discovery respects discovery_enabled flag properly
bug_fixes: Download failure tracking: _update_database_failure() now creates/updates Download record
Error persistence: Errors stored in error_message and last_error fields
History visibility: Failed downloads now visible in download history
API key security: YouTube API keys removed from error messages and logs
Discovery filtering: Auto-discovery only runs on discovery_enabled artists
Manual discovery: Works regardless of discovery_enabled flag
inherited_from_v0_11_3: 🐛 Download queue processing - videos no longer stuck in queued status
🐛 Cookie status checks both file and database
🐛 YouTube API errors properly reported in artist discovery
inherited_from_v0_11_2: 🔧 PO token provider integration for YouTube bot detection bypass
upgrade_notes: 🔄 Download errors will now be visible in history
📊 Retry failed downloads to see error messages
🔒 API keys are now sanitized from all error outputs
